ngaap.guidance: L3Harris (combined company) guidance initiated: second half calendar 2019 (two quarters ending 3-Jan-2020): revenue $9.2 - $9.3 billion (up 9.5% - 10.5% vs combined 2H18); GAAP EPS $2.31 - $2.41; non-GAAP EPS $4.95 - $5.05 (adds back amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ~1.05, L3 inventory step-up ~0.56, L3 deal and integration costs ~1.03); operating cash flow $1.07 - $1.12 billion; capex ~$190 million; adjusted free cash flow $1.30 - $1.35 billion. Calendar 2019: revenue $18.0 - $18.1 billion; GAAP EPS $6.35 - $6.45; non-GAAP EPS $9.60 - $9.70; operating cash flow $2.26 - $2.31 billion; adjusted free cash flow $2.30 - $2.35 billion.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted EBIT (first used in this release) = net income + net interest expense + income taxes + discontinued operations + L3 deal and integration costs; it therefore INCLUDES non-operating pension income and is after Exelis intangible amortization. Non-GAAP EPS excludes L3 deal and integration costs (0.54 pre-tax, tax (0.14)); Exelis intangible amortization is NOT excluded for Harris standalone FY2019 (the forward L3Harris guidance does exclude acquisition-related amortization). Free cash flow = operating cash flow less capital expenditures; adjusted free cash flow adds back cash used for L3 deal and integration costs (31). Pro forma / combined tables exist in this release and are NOT used: Table 8 (combined L3 + Harris adjusted EBIT, quarter and two quarters ended 28-Jun-2019), Table 9 (combined adjusted EPS) and Table 10 (combined 2H18 / CY18 revenue), plus the "Unaudited Combined L3 and Harris Historical Financial Information" summary and Exhibit 99.2.

notes: is.lines_raw = 10-K statement of income (first column) followed by the earnings-release condensed statement lines (prefixed "[Q4 release ...]"), which add dividends per share and weighted average shares; mapped keys use the 10-K. is.op_income is computed (sales - cogs - sga - other operating lines); the statement of income prints no operating income line. is.dps: from the 10-K (selected financial data / statement of equity: cash dividends $2.74 per share); the FY2019 release does not print dividends per share. bs.tl is computed (total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities); not printed. cf.pension_contrib and cf.pension_income are as presented in the cash flow statement (pension income is a negative non-cash adjustment). is.nci is signed as a deduction (negative = loss attributable to noncontrolling interests added back). bs.st_debt = Short-term debt + Current portion of long-term debt (sum). cf.da = sum of the depreciation / amortization lines where split. cf.divest = sum of the proceeds-from-sale lines (businesses, discontinued operations, asset group, adjustments). The cover-page share count (223.3m at 16-Aug-2019) is after the issue of 104.1m shares for the L3 merger; shares outstanding at 28-Jun-2019 were 118.55m. The 10-KT later re-presents the FY2019 cash flow with different line items (depreciation and amortization 258 combined; pension and other postretirement benefit plan income (150)); this record uses the FY2019 10-K as filed.
